method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks rally, while oil and dollar ease on Middle East peace hopes
Equities.reason: Market-wide risk-on impulse: reports that Middle East de-escalation/US-Iran deal hopes pushed oil and the dollar lower, which typically boosts global equities and risk assets. This is a broad macro liquidity/risk narrative likely to support indexes and cyclical sectors.

Equities.title: Emerging-Market Assets Rise as Oil Drops on US-Iran Deal Hopes
Equities.reason: EM-specific risk-on: falling oil and easing geopolitical risk lift EM currencies and equities. Reinforces the cross-market peace/oil narrative and supports regional equity flows and risk appetite.

Equities.title: AI Rally Drives Best Run in Global Momentum Stocks on Record
Equities.reason: Market-regime/leadership narrative: AI-led leadership continuing to drive momentum and index performance is a dominant equity theme. This supports large-cap tech/AI names and momentum strategies, and signals concentration of gains in AI beneficiaries.

Equities.title: Bulls push the S&P 500 back near records — here’s what drove the market last week
Equities.summary: The combination of higher oil prices and bond market volatility nearly snapped the S&P 500's winning streak.
Equities.reason: Broad-index update: S&P near records supports a constructive equity view, but the note flags bond volatility and commodity moves as immediate risks—so mildly positive for equities but with a cautionary macro cross-check.

Equities.title: China Traders Rush for Exit After Cross-Border Flow Crackdown
Equities.reason: China/HK risk-off: regulatory/crackdown flow restrictions trigger sharp local selling and capital flight, weighing on China- and Hong Kong-listed equities and potentially spilling into broader EM sentiment. This is a focused but high-impact negative for regional markets.

Equities.title: Indian shares to open higher on US-Iran peace deal optimism
Equities.reason: Regional equities reaction: India benefits from a broader risk-on impulse tied to Iran/Hormuz developments, supporting local markets and reinforcing the EM upside theme, though it is a regional rather than global driver.

Equities.title: Resurgent Political Risk Derails Rallies Across Emerging Markets
Equities.reason: Countervailing EM narrative: political volatility is undermining EM rallies in some countries, a negative force that offsets some of the Iran-driven risk-on flow. Included as a material counter-signal to the more bullish geopolitical headlines.

Rates.title: Strategists Warn Yields to Stay High Even If Iran War Ends
Rates.reason: Direct market commentary that the shock to risk premia and inflation/terminal-rate expectations will keep global yields elevated even if geopolitical tail-risk eases — large negative for bond prices and the dominant rates narrative.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, April 28-29, 2026
Rates.reason: Primary-source insight into FOMC deliberations — minutes likely reinforce a data-dependent but cautious stance that keeps rate expectations higher for longer; high structural relevance for US yields and global curve.

Rates.title: Kevin Warsh takes oath of office as chairman and a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and the Federal Open Market Committee unanimously selects Warsh as its chairman
Rates.summary: Kevin Warsh takes oath of office as chairman and a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and the Federal Open Market Committee unanimously selects Warsh as its chairman
Rates.reason: New Fed chair is a major regime signal; markets price uncertainty about the policy tilt and potential for a higher-for-longer stance while transition effects work through market plumbing — net modest negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Warsh’s Fed ‘Regime Change’ May Require Patience, Consensus
Rates.reason: Analysis that a Fed policy regime shift will be gradual increases near-term policy uncertainty and keeps markets cautious on easing — modestly negative for yields (less chance of early cuts).

Rates.title: Japan Bond Yield Surge Deepens Regional Bank Stock Divide
Rates.reason: Reports of a sharper move higher in JGB yields are directly negative for bond prices and show local spillovers into banking sector valuations — reinforces a global narrative of higher yields and regional stress.

Rates.title: Japan Bonds Face Homegrown Downside Risks Even as Oil Retreats
Rates.reason: Domestic factors in Japan (wage, policy, supply) keeping pressure on local yields despite easing oil — negative for JGB prices and supportive of a broader higher-yield regime in Asia.

Rates.title: India Bond Investors Tap Soaring Swap Rates to Juice Returns
Rates.reason: Rising swap rates in India indicate higher domestic funding costs and steeper local yields — regionally relevant signal of tighter global/EM rates and risk premia, negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: ECB Hike May Be Inevitable to Keep Credibility, Stournaras Says
Rates.reason: Public comments from an influential ECB policymaker suggesting further hikes raise Euro-area rate expectations and push core yields higher — negative for European sovereign bond prices.

Rates.title: Singapore reports lower-than-expected inflation for April at 1.8%, revises economic growth higher
Rates.summary: Core inflation — which strips out prices of private transport and accommodation — came in at 1.4%, against estimates of 1.7%.
Rates.reason: Lower-than-expected CPI print points to weaker near-term inflation pressure in a small open economy — modestly positive for local bonds (yields down) and a counterpoint to the higher-yield narrative.

Rates.title: Week Ahead: Inflation's summer test
Rates.reason: Preview of upcoming inflation releases that will determine whether central banks can pivot — leans negative because the piece frames inflation as the key test that could keep policy tighter.

Rates.title: Fed: Warsh ambiguity clouds Dollar outlook – DBS
Rates.summary: Philip Wee at DBS highlights uncertainty around new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s approach, noting President Trump’s preference for lower rates and Warsh’s reform-oriented stance.
Rates.reason: Commentary on Fed leadership ambiguity increases near-term policy and FX uncertainty; modest negative tilt for rates as markets wrestle with the path of policy and intervention.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) dips to the 99.00 area on Middle East peace hopes
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) gapped lower at the start of Monday’s session, retreating from the 99.30 area, the lower limit of last week’s trading range, to 99.00.
FX.reason: Direct evidence USD weakening on improving US‑Iran peace hopes; a clear market-wide USD move increases probability of strength in EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD and drives the dominant FX risk‑on narrative.

FX.title: 6% fall in one day: WTI Oil price tumbles on hopes of Hormuz reopening
FX.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, are down 6% to near $90 in the European trading session on Monday, the lowest level seen in over two weeks.
FX.reason: Large oil price drop on reopening hopes reduces the geopolitical risk premium and supports risk assets / non‑USD currencies; commodity FX (AUD, NOK, RUB) and risk crosses benefit, though it creates mixed impulses for oil‑linked CAD.

FX.title: Forex Today: Risk flows dominate markets on US-Iran deal hopes
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Monday, May 25:
FX.reason: Summary piece that captures the dominant intraday FX driver: US‑Iran peace optimism shifting flows into risk currencies and away from safe‑haven USD/JPY — high relevance as it consolidates multiple cross‑asset signals.

FX.title: European shares climb to over two-month highs on Iran-US peace optimism
FX.reason: Equity risk‑on confirmed by European bourses rising on peace optimism — supports the FX narrative of USD weakening and broader currency appreciation in risk assets.

FX.title: US Dollar: Resilience and geopolitical risks – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that higher US 2-year yields and elevated Brent prices are supporting broader USD strength, with markets now fully pricing one Fed rate hike by January 2027.
FX.reason: Counter‑signal: higher US short yields and oil momentum can sustain USD support despite peace optimism. Relevant as a moderating factor on the USD‑weakness/risk‑on trade.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains ground amid hopes of a deal to reopen the ​Strait of Hormuz
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair edges lower to around 1.3805 during the early European session on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) after US officials signal progress on a peace deal with Iran.
FX.reason: Pair‑level confirmation of the broader risk‑on move: CAD firming on peace progress and USD softness. Useful representative cross‑market confirmation (commodity exposure and risk sentiment).

FX.title: British Pound builds on intraday gains vs weaker USD; approaches 1.3500 on Iran deal hopes
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair is seen building on its modest bullish opening gap on Monday and recovering further from its lowest level since April 8, around the 1.3300 round figure touched last week.
FX.reason: GBP strength versus USD aligns with the risk‑on / USD‑weakness narrative driven by peace negotiations; pair confirms broad market flow into risk currencies.

FX.title: Iran's Foreign Ministry: Management of Hormuz belongs to coastal countries
FX.summary: A spokesperson from the Iranian Foreign Ministry said during the European session on Monday that Tehran is "negotiating an end to the war and is not currently discussing nuclear issues." He added, "Management of the strait belongs to the coastal countries."
FX.reason: Official signalling from Iran that talks are focused on ending the war (not nuclear) is a direct political catalyst for reduced Gulf risk premium — supports the USD‑weak / risk‑on FX narrative.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention needs BoJ support – HSBC
FX.summary: HSBC analysts argue that foreign exchange intervention alone is unlikely to keep the USD/JPY pair sustainably below 160. They stress that effectiveness increases when intervention coincides with Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate hikes and lower Oil prices.
FX.reason: Policy/structural note that intervention without BoJ tightening is limited — implies JPY vulnerability and potential USD/JPY upside. Acts as an important constraint on JPY gains within the broader risk‑on move.

Commodities.title: Gold rises on weaker dollar as investor weigh US-Iran peace deal prospects
Commodities.reason: Gold up driven by weaker USD and hopes of a US‑Iran deal — meaningful for precious metals demand and cross-commodity safe-haven flows; broad market/geopolitical driver increases relevance.

Commodities.reason: Record industrial gas demand is a strong fundamental driver for nat‑gas markets (and related thermal fuels), tightening balances and supporting prices — high relevance for commodities.

Commodities.title: Data center server energy use grows across the commercial building stock
Commodities.summary: In the Annual Energy Outlook 2026 (AEO2026), our long-term outlook, we project electricity consumed by data center servers will increase across the commercial building stock, increasing more in standalone data centers than in all other data center rooms combin
Commodities.reason: Structural rise in electricity (and potential gas/coal for power generation) demand from expanding data centers supports energy commodity demand over the medium term; relevant but longer‑dated.

Commodities.title: Brent: Range-bound swings with Middle East risk – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank’s RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets team notes that Brent Oil has fallen 5% again despite ongoing Middle East tensions, underscoring a pattern of repeated price pullbacks.
Commodities.reason: Notes of repeated Brent pullbacks despite geopolitical risk signal softened near-term oil upside and rangebound behavior — modest bearish near-term impact on oil.

Commodities.title: Swiss Trader Had Lucrative Role Getting Iraqi Oil Through Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Evidence of continued oil flows through Hormuz (and workaround trade) increases supply availability and reduces risk premia — mild bearish impact on oil prices.

Commodities.title: Brent Crude Is Up 85% Since January. OXY, XOM, and CVX Are Playing It Very Differently.
Commodities.reason: Large YTD Brent rally indicates sustained tightness or demand strength; important for energy sector capital allocation and continued commodity price momentum.

Commodities.title: The regional differences in gasoline prices this Memorial Day
Commodities.summary: Against the backdrop of a nationwide increase in gasoline prices, regional dynamics including local supply and demand conditions, state fuel specifications, and state taxes influence the different prices drivers see at the pump.
Commodities.reason: National gasoline price increases point to stronger fuel demand and tighter regional supply — modest positive for refined product markets.

Commodities.title: Coal remains competitive for power generation in the central United States
Commodities.summary: In the first four months of 2026, electricity, natural gas, and coal prices suggested continued favorable economics for coal generation in MISO. The dark spread of coal, the difference between the fuel costs for coal-fired generation and the wholesale electric
Commodities.reason: Coal’s competitive economics versus gas/power in parts of the US supports continued thermal coal demand for generation — positive for coal markets.

Commodities.title: Rubio says Washington will find ‘another way’ if Iran talks fail
Commodities.summary: Price of oil falls on hopes of an agreement that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Political comments and reported easing of Hormuz risk have already pushed oil prices lower; near‑term bearish impulse for energy markets tied to diplomacy.

Crypto.title: Clarity Act could spark a boom in crypto ‘yield-as-a-service’
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity (Clarity Act) enabling yield-products would attract capital and expand on-chain financial services — a material adoption/liquidity positive for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Tom Emmer brushes off law enforcement concerns over Clarity Act
Crypto.reason: Reinforces legislative momentum behind the Clarity Act; a confirming datapoint that increases the chance regulatory easing reaches markets (supportive but incremental).

Crypto.title: SEC Commissioner Peirce counters views that crypto rule will foster synthetic tokens
Crypto.reason: Regulatory messaging from an SEC commissioner that disputes negative readings lowers perceived regulatory risk and supports institutional product development, but impact is modest.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin options are coming to Nasdaq. Here's what it means for you.
Crypto.reason: Listing Bitcoin options on Nasdaq signals deeper institutional derivatives access and liquidity — structurally positive for price discovery and institutional flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin tanks to $74,300 as spot ETFs bleed $2.26 billion in two weeks
Crypto.reason: Material ETF outflows represent real liquidity pressure on BTC price; a significant negative for near-term market structure and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Crypto rails are becoming the default payment layer for AI agents, report says
Crypto.reason: Integration of crypto payment rails with AI agents is a large TAM/adoption narrative tying crypto to the AI growth theme — highly bullish for long-term demand and on-chain activity.

Crypto.title: AI is speeding up the quantum threat to crypto, security experts warn
Crypto.reason: Acceleration of quantum threats raises security and protocol risk for crypto assets — a meaningful negative for investor confidence and long-term infrastructure assumptions.

Crypto.title: Congress hits Polymarket and Kalshi with a massive insider trading probe
Crypto.reason: High-profile enforcement scrutiny of prediction markets increases legal and operational risk for on-chain wagering/exchange products — negative for that niche and reputationally for the sector.

Crypto.title: Hyperliquid is emerging as a challenger to traditional exchanges and prediction markets, says FalconX
Crypto.reason: New exchange/prediction-market entrants can boost liquidity and product innovation; positive for market microstructure though niche compared with larger macro drivers.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin trades above $77,000 as oil's 5% slide pushes Asian equities higher
Crypto.reason: Short-term risk-on equity flows and cross-asset moves can lift BTC intraday; a modest, transient positive driven by macro risk appetite.

Crypto.title: A massive $1 trillion hidden market is waiting to be unlocked in bitcoin, says new report
Crypto.reason: Analysis pointing to a large latent market for bitcoin underscores structural demand potential; positive narrative for medium-term allocation into BTC.
